::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 25th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 82-83
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Many, many thanks for prompt [payment](organizations/other_160.qmd), an agreeable sight on a winter’s morning  I think [the story](cmy_books/cmybook_131.qmd) in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd)will finish there about next spring  It is not longer than the [Three Brides](cmy_books/cmybook_120.qmd), but has been in short chapters. I have not finished writing it yet, but the beginning may be printed when it is convenient. I am correcting the [Moors and Christians](cmy_books/cmybook_126.qmd) gradually, and will send the result soon  I see one or two little corrections are wanting in the [Primer](cmy_books/cmybook_353.qmd). When shall I send them

Yours truly
C M Yonge
